title: SseFrameTooLarge terminates stream (state=None) rather than yielding and continuing
description: When the SSE buffer exceeds 1 MiB, the stream yields the error and sets state=None (terminating). A future contributor might suggest continuing the stream by discarding the oversized buffer. They must not — after a buffer overflow we have lost frame boundaries; there is no safe way to continue parsing. Termination is the correct defensive behavior. The caller (who receives the error) is responsible for reconnecting.
